preconditions.description: The number of cities in Mancunia is between 1 and 100000.
The number of roads in Mancunia is between 1 and 200000.
The cities are numbered from 1 to N and the roads are unidirectional.

preconditions.expression: There are no multiple roads in the same direction and no road from a city to itself.
preconditions.description: The input road network is well-defined.

postconditions.expression: Output is either 'YES' followed by E lines or 'NO'.
postconditions.description: The output must clearly indicate whether a solution exists and, if so, provide the final orientations of the roads.

postconditions.expression: If 'YES', then for every city in the country, there is a path to visit each city and traverse each road exactly once before returning to the starting city.
postconditions.description: The output must represent a tourist-friendly road network.

postconditions.expression: If 'NO', then no such rerouting can make the road network tourist-friendly.
postconditions.description: The output must correctly indicate the impossibility of achieving a tourist-friendly network.
